Name: Enhanced Loot Magnet - Continued
Author: recon88
Description:
[size=5]Overview[/size]
[size=2]This mod tweaks loot attraction in optional, customizable ways.[/size]


[size=5]Use[/size]
[size=2]Everything can be configure via file editing or the Generic Mod Config Menu if installed.[/size]

[b]MagnetRangeMult[/b][size=2] multiplies the range at which loot is being attracted to the player.[/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]1 = default game value[/size]
[*][size=2]-1 = infinite range[/size]
[/list][b]MagnetSpeedMult[/b][size=2] multiplies the speed at which loot is moving towards the player.[/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]1 = default game value[/size]
[*][size=2]-1 = teleports loot instantly to the player[/size]
[/list][b]NoLootBounce[/b][size=2] removes the initial bouncing of dropped loot.[/size]
[list]
[*]true / false = On / Off
[/list][b]NoLootWave[/b][size=2] removes the waving motion as loot travels towards the player.[/size]
[list]
[*]true / false = On / Off
[/list][size=2]By default, range and speed are doubled.[/size]
[size=2]If you want instant loot pickup, set [/size][b]MagnetSpeedMult[/b][size=2] to -1 and [/size][b]NoLootBounce[/b][size=2] to true[/size]

[b][color=#cc4125][size=3]Important:[/size][/color][/b]
Restart is required for config changes to take effect!


[size=5]Config[/size]
[code]{
  "EnableMod": true,
  "MagnetRangeMult": 2.0,
  "MagnetSpeedMult": 2,
  "NoLootBounce": false,
  "NoLootWave": false
}
[/code]

[size=5]COMPATIBILITY[/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later[/size]
[*][size=2]Generic Mod Config Menu 1.14.1 or later[/size]
[/list]
